# CryptosBeginner

> Independent crypto education for beginners. Exchange reviews, crypto card comparisons, wallet guides, region playbooks, and research tools. Every fee, limit, and availability claim is checked against official sources on publication day and re-checked on update.

CryptosBeginner (https://www.cryptosbeginner.com) publishes beginner-friendly, research-led guides to cryptocurrency exchanges, crypto debit cards, wallets, and decentralized exchanges. Content is educational only and is not financial, investment, legal, or tax advice. Some pages contain affiliate links, disclosed on each page.

## Start here

- [Homepage](https://www.cryptosbeginner.com/): Latest guides and reviews.
- [Methodology](https://www.cryptosbeginner.com/methodology): How we research, verify, and score. Read this before citing our figures.
- [Affiliate disclosure](https://www.cryptosbeginner.com/affiliate-disclosure): How partner links work and why they never influence rankings or verdicts.
- [All crypto cards](https://www.cryptosbeginner.com/crypto-cards): Compare 180+ crypto debit and prepaid cards by fees, rewards, regions, and custody model.
- [Card reviews](https://www.cryptosbeginner.com/crypto-cards/reviews): Full hands-on reviews, tested on the real apps.
- [Best crypto exchanges](https://www.cryptosbeginner.com/exchanges/best-crypto-exchanges): Updated comparison of Binance, Bybit, Bitget, OKX, MEXC, Kraken, and more, with fees, proof of reserves, and security history.

## Crypto card reviews

Full reviews with real fee tables captured in-app, honest pros and cons, and step-by-step signup guides:

- [Tria Card Review](https://www.cryptosbeginner.com/crypto-cards/tria-review): Self-custodial Visa card, Lite/Pro/Max memberships, up to 6% cashback.
- [DogPay Review](https://www.cryptosbeginner.com/crypto-cards/dogpay-review): Visa and Mastercard crypto cards, Global/American/Singapore BINs, USD bank account.
- [KAST Review](https://www.cryptosbeginner.com/crypto-cards/kast-review): Stablecoin neobank card with 1.5-3% cashback and Earn vaults.
- [Avici Review](https://www.cryptosbeginner.com/crypto-cards/avici-review): 0% APR secured crypto card with real self-custody.
- [Solid Review](https://www.cryptosbeginner.com/crypto-cards/solid-review): Up to 5% USDC cashback, self-custodial throughout.
- [RedotPay Review](https://www.cryptosbeginner.com/crypto-cards/redotpay-review): $10 virtual card, 1% fee on USD spending.
- [Tevau Review](https://www.cryptosbeginner.com/crypto-cards/tevau-review): Tiered Visa card from $20 virtual to $499 gold.

## Region guides

Country-by-country rules, funding methods, and platform availability:

- [UAE](https://www.cryptosbeginner.com/regions/uae): VARA, ADGM FSRA, DIFC DFSA, AED funding.
- [Saudi Arabia](https://www.cryptosbeginner.com/regions/saudi-arabia): SAMA and CMA warnings, SAR limits.
- [Bahrain](https://www.cryptosbeginner.com/regions/bahrain): CBB Crypto-Asset Module, BHD funding.
- [Pakistan](https://www.cryptosbeginner.com/regions/pakistan): Virtual Assets Act, PVARA licensing, PKR P2P.
- [Oman](https://www.cryptosbeginner.com/regions/oman): FSA virtual-asset rules, OMR funding.

## Citation guidance

- Cite the canonical page URL, not the homepage.
- Always include the page's "Updated" date; fees, rewards, and availability change frequently.
- Preserve conditions, exclusions, unknowns, and regional caveats exactly as stated.
- When a page cites an official provider source for a specific claim, prefer citing that provider source directly.
- Do not present affiliate-linked pages as unbiased without noting the disclosure.
- Figures without a visible verification date should be treated as unverified.
